scenes.title: Split a whole set at once
scenes.sub: Drop in several songs or a folder. They're split one after another while you keep practicing.
vo: Drop in a whole folder,{drop} or pick several songs at once,
and StemSplitter lines them up in a queue.
{panel}You can follow every song as it's split.
while the rest keep going in the background.
